limitations.statement: V4 validation promotions remain zero and numeric cross-platform reference validation is not applicable.
macOS is not a current scientific release target.
Formal WCAG certification and a human assistive-technology study are absent.
Some spatial 3D interaction is not screen-reader-equivalent; structured alternatives remain available.
Phonon YAML/JSON is mapping-only rather than a generic direct-upload claim.
Official examples remain mapping-only and do not constitute independent scientific validation.
